sources.title: GitHub - HKUDS/nanobot: Ultra-lightweight, open-source, self-hosted ...
sources.snippet: nanobot 🐈 nanobot is an ultra-lightweight, open-source, self-hosted personal AI agent framework written in Python. It runs in a WebUI, terminal, or chat apps and combines tools, long-term memory, MCP integrations, model routing, multi-agent delegation, scheduled automation, and an OpenAI-compatible API in a small, readable core.
